messages:
Anya: quick sync — we're planning the EdgeEmbed refapp launch next month. Need: launch post, benchmark narrative, a short tutorial, + a webinar to drive OSS signups. Who can own the bench narrative and webinar ops?
Matt: I can take bench narrative. want a few perf slices: latency @ 512 tokens, cost/tk, and a tiny throughput table. I’ll mock some charts.
Jules: I’ll own the tutorial + refapp docs. timeline?
Anya: thanks. target publish date 2026-04-14. webinar the following week, 04-21. Slides + bench by 04-07 for review.
Sam: can we route webinar signups to a HubSpot form? I can wire the form -> sales queue, tag leads with "refapp-edgeembed" utm. Also add a developer track option.
Priya: I'll draft the launch post headline and 3 lead bullets. Will share version for tone (dev-first) by Tue.
Matt: suggestion for bench narrative: emphasize predictable p99 latency improvements from caching + quantization. show cost per 1k tokens vs baseline.
Jules: tutorial plan: 15-min quickstart, code snippet, docker compose, and a small local-bench script. want to include a pre-made gist.
Anya: also plan community channels: announce in #community, devrel newsletter, and OSS repo release notes. @deploy-bot can we schedule a deploy/announce reminder?
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-04-14T09:00Z in #community and #marketing :rocket:
Sam: routing: inbound form -> sales + product-intel. Also create an alias for "edgeembed@redwood.ai" for technical follow-ups.
Priya: I’ll A/B test two CTAs: "Try EdgeEmbed" vs "Run the quickstart" — we'll track via UTM and initial CTR.
Matt: will push benchmark artifacts to /artifacts/edgeembed/baselines and send short CSV + pngs.
Jules: will open PR for tutorial in docs repo. reviewers: @anya, @matt, @priya.
Anya: perfect. next check-in Fri 04-04 10am PT. If anyone blocked ping me.
Priya: noted. I’ll post draft by Tue EOD.
Sam: form created, will share link here when done.
Matt: done with first perf run, sharing numbers in the thread:  p50 70ms, p95 180ms, p99 320ms (512 tokens, batch=8) — will refine.
Jules: love the perf numbers — good hook for the post.
Anya: thanks team. small ask: use "developer-first" language and include migration notes from previous refapp.
Sam: shared form link: https://hubspot.example/form/edgeembed — tagging leads as "lead:edgeembed"
Priya: draft posted: https://docs.google.com/draft-edgeembed — feedback welcome.
Matt: I pushed charts: https://storage.example/edgeembed/bench-2026-03-#{shortid}
Anya: great. I'll assemble a copy deck and DM reviewers.
deploy-bot: Deploy window for release notes set: 2026-04-14T09:05Z -> will post automatically after PR merge.
Jules: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/refapps/pull/342 — tutorial + quickstart included.
Anya: closing loop — everyone add checklist items in the shared notion page: https://redwood.notion.site/EdgeEmbed-Launch
Sam: ack.
Matt: ack.
Priya: ack.
Jules: ack.
